title: Build the hosted unit catalog
responsibility: Combine committed unit manifests and plans into catalog entries and relationships.

inputs.name: hubCatalog.context
inputs.description: Authorized source context with repository, pinned commit, tree entries, source adapter and cache identity.

inputs.name: hubAttestPlan.plan
inputs.description: Plan to attest against a registered unit or draft identity.

inputs.name: hubAttestPlan.unit
inputs.description: Matching manifest, or undefined for an unregistered draft.

inputs.name: hubRelationships.items
inputs.description: Catalog entries supplying related plan and verification status.

inputs.name: hubOwnedPaths.context
inputs.description: Authorized source context with repository, pinned commit, tree entries, source adapter and cache identity.

outputs.name: hubCatalog
outputs.description: Combined title-sorted items, listed entries, units, plans and plan records, with changed paths reflected in catalog metadata.

outputs.name: hubAttestPlan
outputs.description: Returns nothing when kinds match, or when an unregistered plan uses category.slug; otherwise rejects as artifact-corrupt.

outputs.name: hubRelationships
outputs.description: Related units with uses/used-by direction, category, plan presence and verification; a reciprocal dependency is shown as used-by.

outputs.name: hubOwnedPaths
outputs.description: Blob paths equal to or beneath the unit’s declared source paths.
